caption: Open source
heading: Built in public
description: Interactive demos of recent ML papers and Node.js security basics, AI video tooling, a Toronto parking-ticket checker, and visualizations, each with readable source you can run.

featured.name: Algo Vision
featured.description: Twenty-two interactive visualizations of how things actually compute — from bubble sort to Raft consensus, from Bloom filters to the Bloch sphere. Pause anywhere and read the pseudocode in lockstep.

tools.name: Reference Packer
tools.description: Packs several reference images into one clean sheet per subject for AI video on Higgsfield, lints it for lighting and resolution, and builds the prompt for Seedance, Kling, Wan, Veo or Gemini Omni. Runs entirely in the browser; Python CLI included.

tools.name: Ticket Risk TO
tools.description: Tells you how likely you are to get a parking ticket on your Toronto block at the hour you're parking, scored 0–100 from 3.4 million City of Toronto tickets, with quieter times to park instead. Free, no sign-up, installs on your phone.

series.name: Node.js security
series.description: Four runnable Node.js repos covering the security basics every backend needs: injection, HTTP hardening, the npm supply chain, and crypto.

repos.name: nodejs-injection-defense
repos.topics: Command, SQL, path traversal, prototype pollution, ReDoS
repos.title: Injection defense
repos.description: Five classic injection bugs, each with the exploit, the fix and a test that proves it.

repos.name: nodejs-http-hardening
repos.topics: Headers, body limits, timeouts, rate limiting, CORS, safe errors
repos.title: HTTP hardening
repos.description: A zero-dependency Node.js server that sets safe headers, limits bodies, times out slow clients and rate-limits.

repos.name: nodejs-supply-chain-security
repos.topics: npm config, CI auditing, install-script scanning, permission model
repos.title: Supply-chain security
repos.description: Safe npm config, CI auditing, an install-script scanner and the Node permission model.

repos.name: nodejs-crypto-secrets
repos.topics: Password hashing, tokens, JWTs, encryption, secrets
repos.title: Crypto and secrets
repos.description: Password hashing, secure tokens, JWT checks and AES-GCM encryption with node:crypto.

repos.name: gated-attention-minimal
repos.description: One sigmoid gate after SDPA — and the measurements to see what it does.

repos.name: titans-minimal
repos.description: A neural memory that trains itself by gradient descent during the forward pass.
repos.paper: Titans: Learning to Memorize at Test Time

repos.name: gspo-minimal
repos.description: The sequence-level RL post-training objective behind Qwen3, with a GRPO baseline.

repos.name: muon-minimal
repos.description: Orthogonalized momentum, plus the two changes that made Muon work at LLM scale.
repos.paper: Muon is Scalable for LLM Training

repos.name: nsa-minimal
repos.description: Compression, selection, and sliding-window branches mixed by a learned per-head gate.
